note: Shape: {"source-name": {"note"?, "provenance": {<subject>: "fetched:<url>"|"fetched-secondary:<url>"}, "<Subject>": [{"chapter": str, "topics": [{"name": str, "subtopics": [str,...], "activities": [{"kind": "practice|quiz|unit-test|challenge|interactive|video", "name": str}]}], "chapter_activities": [{"kind":..., "name":...}]}]}}. "activities" on a topic are exercises the source attaches to that specific lesson/section. "chapter_activities" are assessments/projects the source attaches at the whole chapter/unit level (end-of-chapter review sets, unit tests, projects) rather than to one topic -- both are real, never invented. For OpenStax's standard college-style textbooks (Physics, Chemistry 2e, Concepts of Biology, World History, American Government, Principles of Economics, Introduction to Computer Science, Introduction to Python Programming) the source nav tree exposes only chapter->section (2 levels), so true subtopics (the ideas inside one section) and per-topic activities were extracted from that section's own page content (its 'Learning Objectives' box and named pedagogical asides like 'Checkpoint'/'Try It') for a representative sample of the first 3 chapters of each such book; later chapters keep real topic names but an empty subtopics/activities array pending fuller extraction (documented per source, not fabricated). OpenStax Algebra 1 is K12-authored and its nav tree already runs Unit -> Lesson -> numbered idea, so it needed no extra fetch and is populated for every chapter. Computer Science and Social Science are composites of multiple OpenStax course tracks (chapter names carry a '[Track]' prefix identifying which book contributed them) since no single OpenStax book covers the whole canonical subject.

sources-attempted.khanacademy.org: BLOCKED. /api/v1/topictree and /api/v1/topic/* return HTTP 410 (API removed, confirmed via github.com/Khan/khan-api). Course pages (e.g. /math/algebra) return a 'Client Challenge' bot-detection shell (~3KB, JS-gated) instead of content -- not fetchable by scripted request, matching the brief's own note that Khan blocks scripted fetchers.
sources-attempted.openstax.org: WORKED. No bot protection. Book list via public CMS API (openstax.org/apps/cms/api/v2/pages/?type=books.book). Each book page embeds a full chapter/section nav tree in window.__PRELOADED_STATE__, and section pages are server-rendered with real 'Learning Objectives' + pedagogical note blocks. Used as the primary source for all 6 subjects.
sources-attempted.ck12.org: Reachable (HTTP 200 after redirect, e.g. ck12.org/c/algebra/) but not extracted -- OpenStax already gave sufficient sourced depth for every subject, so CK-12 flexbook trees were not pulled to keep the file to genuinely-checked data rather than parsing a second platform for redundant coverage.
sources-attempted.brilliant.org: Reachable (course listing at brilliant.org/courses/ returns HTTP 200) but individual course syllabi were not extracted, same reasoning as CK-12.
sources-attempted.ixl.com: WORKED for one grade. in.ixl.com/maths/class-viii (IXL geo-redirects to a localized site) returns a full skill tree (28 categories, 247 skills) as static HTML. Used as a secondary cross-validation source for Mathematics only; other subjects/grades not attempted.
